SELECT psb.id, psb.sc_id, psb.product_id, psb.quantity, psb.batch_number, psb.production_date, psb.expiry_date, psb.supplier_id, psb.create_time, psb.shelf_location FROM tbl_product_stock_batch psb LEFT JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = psb.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id WHERE 1=1
AND psb.sc_id = #{scId}
AND p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND (p.category_id = #{categoryId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{categoryId}, c.node_path))
AND p.brand_id = #{brandId}
AND psb.batch_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNumber}, '%')
ORDER BY psb.create_time DESC
